title: Retries are idempotent while conflicts and archived transitions fail closed

given.records: a pending approval or open task with persisted natural key and version
given.plant_states: active for the first request, then archived for a later transition
given.classified_message: one ordinary classified message with stable run_id and message_id presented while the Plant is archived

when.requests: repeat an identical request, submit a stale or conflicting request, attempt a transition while archived, restore, and resubmit the denied classified message

then.identical_retry: returns the first committed result without duplication
then.denied_message_reuse: the same run_id or message_id remains ineligible after restore
then.new_invocation: only a new runtime invocation with new run_id and message_id may pass current guards
